listen_address.description: IP address to bind the comsatd daemon to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces or '127.0.0.1' for localhost only).

listen_port.description: Port number on which comsatd listens for incoming connections (default: 16080, the standard COMSAT port).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

debug.description: Enable detailed debug output to syslog (use only for troubleshooting).

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use for logging (e.g., 'daemon', 'local0', 'user').

pidfile_path.description: Path to the PID file where the daemon writes its process ID.

drop_user.description: System username to drop privileges to after startup (for security hardening).

drop_group.description: System group name to drop privileges to after startup (for security hardening).

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging for connection and message handling details.

allowed_hosts.description: List of hostnames or CIDR addresses permitted to connect to comsatd.

denied_hosts.description: List of hostnames or CIDR addresses explicitly denied from connecting.

items.description: A hostname or CIDR subnet to block.

ipv6_enabled.description: Enable or disable IPv6 support (binds to both IPv4 and IPv6 if enabled).

timeout_seconds.description: Idle timeout in seconds for client connections (0 = no timeout).

maildir_path.description: Path to the root mail spool or maildir directory that comsatd monitors for new mail notifications.
